name: Medicine Ball Slam

instructions.description: Stand tall holding a medicine ball with both hands in front of your chest.
Raise the ball overhead while keeping your ribs controlled and your feet grounded.
Forcefully drive the ball downward by flexing through the shoulders and trunk while bending the knees and hips.
Pick the ball up with a safe squat or hinge and reset for the next repetition.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use a slam ball designed to tolerate impact.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Reduce impact and emphasize trunk power in a kneeling position.

commentsNotes: Do not hyperextend the lower back overhead.
Keep fingers clear as the ball rebounds or settles.
